text:
Priya (PM): FYI I've grouped 3 tickets from Acme into one canonical ask re: tenant-level rate limits. SUP-4981, SUP-5002, SALES-773. Need a quick decision: priority + owner. Quick summary below.

Jordan (Support): SUP-4981 = timeouts on burst, customers see 429s when they batch requests. SUP-5002 = ask to surface per-tenant quotas in console. SALES-773 = SLA/contract ask.

Mateo (Product Ops): Do we know if any active Dedicated customers are impacted? @Anika can you confirm customer footprint?

Anika (AE): Acme is on Hosted today but planning Dedicated later this year. They said this is blocking their integration testing right now. :grimacing: Not GA-critical for many customers yet, but painful for them.

Priya (PM): Proposed checklist to pick priority:
1) Customer impact (blocking vs nice-to-have)
2) Number of customers affected
3) Workaround viability
4) Risk/cost (infra + rollout)
If blocking + no workaround -> High. My read: blocking for their tests but there is a client-side retry/backoff workaround -> leaning Medium. Thoughts?

Jordan (Support): Workaround exists but is ugly; they asked specifically for server-side per-tenant throttles + a UI to inspect usage. They'll accept a staged delivery.

Mateo (Product Ops): Rough engineering estimate: core enforcement + infra hooks = ~2-3 sprints; console + telemetry = ~1 sprint. We can split: (A) enforcement + minimal telemetry as priority, (B) console UI as follow-up.

Priya (PM): OK. Decision proposal: mark canonical ticket with tag `triage.clustered` and set priority = P2 (Medium). Owner = Mateo (Product Ops) for implementation coordination, PM owner = Priya. Action items: Mateo to add scope + breakdown in canonical ticket; Jordan to confirm with Acme that Medium timeline is acceptable; Priya will draft customer message.

Anika (AE): They specifically asked for an ETA. Can we give a rough timeline rather than just "medium"?

Priya (PM): I'll propose ETA language: "Prototype enforcement in ~6-8 weeks; GA console in ~12-14 weeks" — label as target, not SLA. @triage-bot can you apply labels?

triage-bot: Label `triage.clustered` applied to TICKET-ACME-1. Assigned: Mateo (Product Ops).

Jordan (Support): I'll tell Acme we plan a prototype in ~6-8 weeks and ask if they can use client-side throttling meanwhile. I'll update SUP-4981 / SUP-5002 when they confirm.

Mateo (Product Ops): I'll post scope + task breakdown in the canonical ticket by EOD. Flagging cross-team risk: needs runtime + console coordination. @eng-runtime FYI.

Priya (PM): Thanks — once the scope is in the ticket I'll send the customer-facing note with the ETA and next steps. Closing this thread for now :thumbsup:
